head: WhatsApp dual camera mode in testing: film with front and back camera
dek: WhatsApp is testing a camera mode on Android that records with the front and back camera at the same time, WABetaInfo reports. It's reaching some beta testers with version 2.26.46.9; WhatsApp hasn't said when everyone gets it.
details: A new button at the top of WhatsApp's camera turns it on: the back camera fills the screen and the front camera sits in a small box you can drag around. A rotate button swaps the two. Photos combine both views and videos record both cameras in one clip, which you can send to chats, groups, channels or Status with a caption. Nothing has been said about an iPhone version.
where: Some Android beta testers (WhatsApp beta 2.26.46.9); not yet for everyone
means: If you like showing your reaction and what you're looking at in one clip, WhatsApp may soon do that without another app.
todo: Nothing to do yet: it's only with some Android beta testers. Keep WhatsApp updated from the Play Store.
